320px layouts enlarge SVG labels, preserve touch targets and avoid clipping

data.relation: Observed wavelength / rest wavelength = sqrt((1 + v/c) / (1 - v/c)); c = 299792.458 km/s
data.scope: Published wavelength references are used. Velocity settings and line widths/strengths are teaching examples. The relation models motion directly along the line of sight; cosmological and gravitational shifts are separate.
